PM SVANidhi

PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi

PM SVANidhi is a Government of India initiative designed to provide affordable working-capital support to eligible street vendors.

👥 Who can benefit?

Eligible street vendors and hawkers, including eligible vendors from surrounding peri-urban and rural areas.

💳 Financial Support

The scheme provides working-capital credit through participating lending institutions. Loan eligibility and current tranches should be checked through the official portal.

📱 Digital Payments

Digital transactions are encouraged under the scheme and can provide incentives to eligible beneficiaries.

🏦 Lending Institutions

Eligible banks and other participating lending institutions can provide credit under the scheme.

✅ General Eligibility Information

  • Applicant should be a street vendor / hawker covered under the applicable scheme guidelines.
  • Vendors may need a Certificate of Vending, Identity Card or other applicable proof.
  • Aadhaar-based KYC and other required documents may be required.
  • Eligibility can depend on the vendor's survey / vending status and applicable government guidelines.

📄 Documents You May Need

  • Aadhaar Card
  • Voter ID / other accepted identity proof
  • Certificate of Vending / Identity Card, where applicable
  • Bank account details
  • Other KYC documents as required

Note: Exact documents can vary depending on the application route and current government requirements.

📝 How to Apply

  1. Check whether you are eligible under the current PM SVANidhi guidelines.
  2. Keep your identity, vending and bank details ready.
  3. Use the official PM SVANidhi portal or an authorised application / lending channel.
  4. Complete the required KYC and application process.
  5. Track your application through the official system.
🌐 Visit Official PM SVANidhi Portal
📱

Digital Payment Support

Digital transactions are an important part of the PM SVANidhi ecosystem. Vendors can use digital payment methods to maintain transaction records and participate in applicable digital payment incentives.

💳 Learn About Online Payments

⚠️ Important Information

  • Always verify scheme information on the official government website before applying.
  • Never pay an unknown person for a guaranteed government scheme benefit.
  • Never share your OTP, UPI PIN, ATM PIN or banking password with anyone.
  • Scheme eligibility, benefits and application rules can change. Always check the latest official information.
